articles.summary: FREEHOLD, NJ, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - UMH Properties, Inc. (NYSE:UMH) (TASE:UMH) reported Total Income for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 of $74.1 million as compared to $66.9 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, representing an increase of 11%. Net Loss Attributable to Common Shareholders amounted to $2.1 million or $0.02 per diluted share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 as compared to Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders of $4.2 million or $0.05 per diluted share for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. Normalized Funds from Operations Attributable to Common Shareholders (“Normalized FFO”), was $22.1 million or $0.26 per diluted share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as compared to $21.3 million or $0.25 per diluted share for the quarter ended September 30, 2025, representing an increase of 4% on both a dollar basis and on a per diluted share basis.
